content.text: Section 18 fully satisfies the preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 contains a vendor-side insurance clause that meets or exceeds every element of the preferred position: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, professional errors and omissions of USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (Vendor processes Customer Data under Sections 15 and 17), workers' compensation as required by law, plus employer's liability of USD 1,000,000 as additional protection. Coverage runs throughout the term and for one year afterward, matching the model language. Section 18.2 adds customer-favourable mechanics: reputable insurers, primary coverage where customary, certificates of insurance and evidence of coverage on request, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities (so the Section 21 caps are not undercut). All obligations bind the counterparty, so nothing here requires a redline.
